title: C# and .NET Interview Prep
description: Practice mid-level C# and .NET interview concepts through runnable C# exercises, code-reading drills, architecture scenarios, and review prompts: a CRUD API built end to end, then modern C# language depth, LINQ, error handling and resilience, and background concurrency.
outcomes: Explain C# runtime and type-system fundamentals in interview language
Map ASP.NET Core endpoint, service, validation, and authorization responsibilities
Reason about EF Core indexes, migrations, transactions, and outbox patterns
Practice mid-level debugging, code review, and system design answers
Choose unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for .NET service behavior
Discuss production readiness through logging, metrics, performance, caching, and secrets
Build a CRUD API end to end: DTOs and validation, paging and sorting, optimistic concurrency with ETags, and idempotent POST
Implement and test each concept as a runnable C# exercise, not just describe it
Use records, with-expressions, pattern matching, nullable reference types, and constrained generics idiomatically
Reason about deferred execution, joins and grouping, collection choice, and IEnumerable vs IQueryable
Design error handling with result types, custom exceptions, deterministic disposal, and retry and timeout policies
Write thread-safe background code with concurrent collections, Interlocked, Channels, and hosted services, and explain why async void is dangerous
